detail.longDescription: 🦅 NEW: A # PNAS study fed more than three decades of black-browed # albatross records into a model that let traits like wing length, # breeding timing, and # behavior evolve as the # climate warms. Evolutionary rescue extended survival under mild warming but strong warming overwhelmed it, with populations declining before helpful traits spread. Cutting # emissions roughly halved projected # extinction probability compared with # evolution alone. 👉 https:// scitechdaily.com/can-species-e volve-fast-enough-to-survive-climate-change/ # climatechange # seabirds # adaptation # biology # conservation # wildlife # animals # nature # ecology # research # ocean # science # birds # ornithology
